correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, the unique-previous-neighbor rule exhausts all vertex-order strong gradients. The core join of n discrete four-point factors yields 3^n spheres in dimension n-1; precisely 2n distinct hub-headed cone attachments meet it in (n-2)-spheres and each attaching map factors through an explicit cone in the core. Repeated nullhomotopic cone attachment proves 3^n+2n spheres. The exact disjoint apex stratum count gives the face polynomial. Exhaustive order or subset-DP face-set comparisons and exact mod-2 homology on n=1,...,5 corroborate all boundary conventions without replacing the proof.

value.rationale: The infinite vertex-amalgamated graph family is natural and occurs under the standard friendship/Dutch-windmill name. Its strong vertex-edge gradient complex is noncontractible with exponentially growing wedge rank even while its ordinary edge-matching complex is known to be contractible. The exact join-plus-hub-cone mechanism explains the change and yields full face enumerators, supplying a structural classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
